title: Bands heard as a boy and singers he knows
summary: No music in his home, but as a child he heard the Maple Leaf band and Freddie Keppard next door, played guitar duo jobs, and now knows blues singers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: We'll ask some more about those. I was going to ask about the, when you were a boy again, you say there wasn't much music in your home, the rest of the family. No, no music in my home.
Can you remember the type of bands you heard?
When you were even five or six years old, can you remember back that far? Sure. What kind of bands they had?

Well they had the Maple Leaf Rag band, the Maple Leaf band. And they had, when I was a youngster, well then, Freddie Kepard, I was living right next door to Freddie's house in the way of speaking, because my aunt used to live there and I used to hear him play all the time, you know what I mean? He was playing the violin at first. And I used to hear him playing, his brother was a guitar player.
Yes, I know him very well. Louis.

Well then, by then playing and then we had a little, we used to play just a guitar, just the two guitars and go out and play little jobs and all that kind of stuff. Were you and Louis? No, me and a boy by the name of Fredolution. I was talking to him yesterday, there's another boy. He's around. Oh yeah, he's around.
Fred knows a lot of these boys and we never hear.

I just forgot a lot of them. Fredolution? Fredolution, now he's a blues singer. That's what he is, he's a blues singer, he's a good blues singer too. I was at his place yesterday and I said, we've got to get together and I want to take you to a friend of mine's house and I said, we're going to go there one day and just sit down and play a couple of numbers, you know what I mean? I just want him to hear you sing the blues. And this other boy, Paul, well he's a sentimental singer, he's a good singer too. Oh there's a lot of fellas around here that play and sing. Where does that he live, this Freddie Lucius? I don't know where he lives but he's a, he's a bobertender at St. Peter in Durginville. You know what I said? St. Peter? Yeah, I remember. That's where he's at. I was there yesterday and the man, you see the man you bought the bass from? Yes. Well then, he's going away. He bought his house and he's going back to pull off to Texas and he's going to, by the way he says, he said, man I got a bass in the back that I'd like to get rid of. I said, well come on, I'll take it to a man right now if you want to go. So we went up there and he wasn't there. Oh you were there too. Yeah.
